run_detail.final_report_title: 研究报告：比较 PostgreSQL 17 与 MySQL 8.4 的 JSON 索引类型、可加速的查询运算符和索引代价，引用官方文档。
run_detail.final_report_markdown:
# PostgreSQL 17 与 MySQL 8.4 的 JSON 索引能力对比 在 JSON 索引方面，PostgreSQL 17 提供 jsonb_ops 和 jsonb_path_ops 操作符类，其中 jsonb_path_ops 通常索引更小、搜索特异性更好；而 MySQL 8.4 支持生成列索引和多值索引，多值索引不能作为覆盖索引。在可加速的查询运算符上，PostgreSQL 17 的 jsonb_ops 支持的运算符包括 @>、@?、@@、?、?|、?&，MySQL 8.4 的多值索引支持 MEMBER OF 和 JSON_CONTAINS。 ## JSON 索引类型 PostgreSQL 17 的 jsonb_ops 操作符类支持 .* 和 .** 访问符，而 jsonb_path_ops 操作符类不支持。 [evidence:fa33e29bb150623830ea24c36a0c58a6669e2ba1982276e1] MySQL 8.4 支持生成列方式，将路径提取为虚拟列或存储列并对其建立索引。 [evidence:dba4de7b41d25e2bc9702cfb01ecf8a729c040b05ed7b785] ## 可加速的查询运算符 PostgreSQL 17 的 jsonb_ops 操作符类可以加速 @>、@?、@@、?、?| 和 ?& 等查询运算符。 [evidence:9fd467e88162bb4620827824539e44e4e3e95fa7cbacc33b] MySQL 8.4 的多值索引可以索引 JSON 数组中的元素，并支持 MEMBER OF 和 JSON_CONTAINS 查询。 [evidence:00fda64bb45621abde1a0c47c54c3ac355dac5f93008aefd] ## 索引代价 在 PostgreSQL 17 中，jsonb_path_ops 索引通常比相同数据上的 jsonb_ops 索引小得多，搜索特异性更好，尤其当查询包含频繁出现的键时。 [evidence:af971490562c9c641b47bdb6ab89dae26678ab07f8e974c9] MySQL 8.4 的多值索引不能作为覆盖索引。 [evidence:b10b99920d2d707f2d710a9fe798a7b943ca4d3d27295364] ## 对比表 | 数据库 | JSON 索引类型 | 可加速的查询运算符 | 索引代价 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | PostgreSQL 17 | jsonb_ops 和 jsonb_path_ops 操作符类；jsonb_ops 支持 .* 和 .** 访问符，jsonb_path_ops 不支持。 | jsonb_ops 支持 @>、@?、@@、?、?\|、?& | jsonb_path_ops 索引通常比 jsonb_ops 小得多，搜索特异性更好，尤其针对频繁键。 [evidence:fa33e29bb150623830ea24c36a0c58a6669e2ba1982276e1] [evidence:9fd467e88162bb4620827824539e44e4e3e95fa7cbacc33b] [evidence:af971490562c9c641b47bdb6ab89dae26678ab07f8e974c9] | | MySQL 8.4 | 生成列索引或多值索引；多值索引不能作为覆盖索引。 | 多值索引支持 MEMBER OF 和 JSON_CONTAINS | 多值索引不能作为覆盖索引。 [evidence:dba4de7b41d25e2bc9702cfb01ecf8a729c040b05ed7b785] [evidence:00fda64bb45621abde1a0c47c54c3ac355dac5f93008aefd] [evidence:b10b99920d2d707f2d710a9fe798a7b943ca4d3d27295364] | ## Citation audit ### MySQL 8.4 · 可加速的查询运算符 - Evidence: `evidence:00fda64bb45621abde1a0c47c54c3ac355dac5f93008aefd` - Exact quote: “Multi-valued indexes (8.0.17+) let you index the elements inside a JSON array directly with `CAST(... AS ... ARRAY)` and use them with `MEMBER OF` and `JSON_CONTAINS`.” - Snapshot: `research/external/63d0a6c5-70c3-48f9-ba8a-d7b3b6775acb/c57357375c5e17a5a377736e6a2904a75425e8ef2ac0ea5e7cfa78b91e960a45` - URL: https://jamsql.com/blog/mysql-json-column-guide/ ### MySQL 8.4 · 索引代价 - Evidence: `evidence:b10b99920d2d707f2d710a9fe798a7b943ca4d3d27295364` - Exact quote: “A multi-valued index cannot be a covering index.” - Snapshot: `research/external/703844f1-8047-49f2-b6ca-3a5c2fb0026a/fce2d5748ac630bef49b0fadc3b9f351157c3a7d6bce49aee9e414769fe12d80` - URL: https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/9.3/en/create-index.html ### MySQL 8.4 · JSON 索引类型 - Evidence: `evidence:dba4de7b41d25e2bc9702cfb01ecf8a729c040b05ed7b785` - Exact quote: “Generated columns let you extract a path into a virtual or stored column and index that.” - Snapshot: `research/external/63d0a6c5-70c3-48f9-ba8a-d7b3b6775acb/c57357375c5e17a5a377736e6a2904a75425e8ef2ac0ea5e7cfa78b91e960a45` - URL: https://jamsql.com/blog/mysql-json-column-guide/ ### PostgreSQL 17 · 可加速的查询运算符 - Evidence: `evidence:9fd467e88162bb4620827824539e44e4e3e95fa7cbacc33b` - Exact quote: “\| `jsonb_ops` \| `@> (jsonb,jsonb)` \|
\| `@? (jsonb,jsonpath)` \|
\| `@@ (jsonb,jsonpath)` \|
\| `? (jsonb,text)` \|
\| `?\| (jsonb,text[])` \|
\| `?& (jsonb,text[])` \|” - Snapshot: `research/external/4a581805-ad27-4f7d-a376-69ac71ab1add/4b60e364f77cb8603d9dba60ae74053da8d45da2b99dcd44432031aa5a9e5283` - URL: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/gin.html ### PostgreSQL 17 · 索引代价 - Evidence: `evidence:af971490562c9c641b47bdb6ab89dae26678ab07f8e974c9` - Exact quote: “A `jsonb_path_ops` index is usually much smaller than a `jsonb_ops` index over the same data, and the specificity of searches is better, particularly when queries contain keys that appear frequently in the data.” - Snapshot: `research/external/4a581805-ad27-4f7d-a376-69ac71ab1add/78eed30b3b315674aed46d85f4ffc86860696b207372cb4e39644e4b0921a32a` - URL: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/datatype-json.html ### PostgreSQL 17 · JSON 索引类型 - Evidence: `evidence:fa33e29bb150623830ea24c36a0c58a6669e2ba1982276e1` - Exact quote: “The `jsonb_ops` operator class also supports `.*` and `.**` accessors, but the `jsonb_path_ops` operator class does not.” - Snapshot: `research/external/4a581805-ad27-4f7d-a376-69ac71ab1add/78eed30b3b315674aed46d85f4ffc86860696b207372cb4e39644e4b0921a32a` - URL: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/datatype-json.html

cells.candidate_value: The `jsonb_ops` operator class also supports `.*` and `.**` accessors, but the `jsonb_path_ops` operator class does not.
A multi-valued index cannot be a covering index.
Generated columns let you extract a path into a virtual or stored column and index that.

A `jsonb_path_ops` index is usually much smaller than a `jsonb_ops` index over the same data, and the specificity of searches is better, particularly when queries contain keys that appear frequently in the data.
Multi-valued indexes (8.0.17+) let you index the elements inside a JSON array directly with `CAST(... AS ... ARRAY)` and use them with `MEMBER OF` and `JSON_CONTAINS`.

questions: 在 JSON 索引选择上，两者官方文档描述的关键能力差异是什么？

data.candidate_value: Multi-valued indexes (8.0.17+) let you index the elements inside a JSON array directly with `CAST(... AS ... ARRAY)` and use them with `MEMBER OF` and `JSON_CONTAINS`.

equivalent_claims.claim_text: Multi-valued indexes (8.0.17+) let you index the elements inside a JSON array directly with `CAST(... AS ... ARRAY)` and use them with `MEMBER OF` and `JSON_CONTAINS`.

data.candidate_value: A multi-valued index cannot be a covering index.

equivalent_claims.claim_text: A multi-valued index cannot be a covering index.

data.candidate_value: Generated columns let you extract a path into a virtual or stored column and index that.

equivalent_claims.claim_text: Generated columns let you extract a path into a virtual or stored column and index that.

data.candidate_value: A `jsonb_path_ops` index is usually much smaller than a `jsonb_ops` index over the same data, and the specificity of searches is better, particularly when queries contain keys that appear frequently in the data.

equivalent_claims.claim_text: A `jsonb_path_ops` index is usually much smaller than a `jsonb_ops` index over the same data, and the specificity of searches is better, particularly when queries contain keys that appear frequently in the data.

data.candidate_value: The `jsonb_ops` operator class also supports `.*` and `.**` accessors, but the `jsonb_path_ops` operator class does not.

equivalent_claims.claim_text: The `jsonb_ops` operator class also supports `.*` and `.**` accessors, but the `jsonb_path_ops` operator class does not.
